historical_claims.anchor: That is Proposition 4.3, and it is correct.
Davis and Kahan already note that Proposition 4.3 implies minimality in the operator norm and the Hilbert–Schmidt norm.

Bolotnikov, Li, and Rodman had earlier studied minimal distortion problems for this class of subspace-transport constraints, including Q-norm minimization and counterexamples for Schatten norms with exponent between one and two.
This is the source of the sixty-degree threshold in the printed Proposition 4.4
